We have a product of two negative numbers, $\color{red}-9$ and ${\color{red}-5}.$ So the product will be positive:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14146707/assets/1793b9f5cb618eb1fe60e0ea34ce271a42e44ca04e92d7546289239fffee2a40.svg)
Now, to compute the number that goes in the box, we multiply $9$ and $5$ without any signs: $9 \cdot 5 = 45.$ So, we get

$$
{\color{red}(-9)} \cdot {\color{red}(-5)} = {\color{blue}45}.
$$
